questions.question: Explain the role of seminal vesicles, prostate gland and Cowper's glands in the formation of semen.
questions.solution_html:
• Explain the role of seminal vesicles, prostate gland and Cowper's glands in the formation
  • of semen. /
  • • Ans: Seminal vesicles: Secrete fructose -rich fluid that supplies energy to sperm and
  • contributes a major portion of semen.
  • • Prostate gland: Adds fluid containing citrate, enzymes and other substances that support
  • sperm function and contribute to semen liquefaction.
  • • Cowper's (bulbourethral) glands: Secrete mucus-like pre-ejaculatory fluid that lubricates the
  • urethra and helps neutralize residual acidity.
  • • Overall role: These secretions combine with sperm and other reproductive tract fluids to
  • form semen, supporting sperm transport and function.
